# US Blacklists Alibaba-Owned Company in Megaspeed Crackdown

By Mackenzie Hawkins, Andy Lin, and Luz Ding

November 23, 2026 at 8:45 PM EST

Updated on 

November 24, 2026 at 3:06 AM EST

## Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

The Trump administration blacklisted a Singaporean subsidiary of Alibaba Group Holding Ltd., roping one of China’s biggest tech companies into its crackdown on Megaspeed International, the firm at the center of a controversy that briefly cost Jensen Huang his job at Nvidia Corp.

In a filing Monday, the Commerce Department added Apex Enterprise Solutions to its so-called entity list, a designation that restricts the company from purchasing AI chips and other advanced technology without a US government license. The move may mark the first instance of Washington wielding that authority against a unit of Alibaba, after standing down on proposed restrictions targeting the company’s cloud business earlier in President Donald Trump’s term.
